# Search repair

**Status:** ready-for-agent
**Blocked by:** none

Restore the accepted Unicode name-search behavior from [the specification](../spec.md). The reported input is an item named Straße queried with STRASSE, which currently returns no match.

steps.prompt: Fix the Unicode search bug reported in the work record.

rubric.description: Reproduce STRASSE failing to match Straße and identify the lower-versus-case-fold cause before changing production behavior.

Retain a unittest regression through the existing search_items interface with independently derived expected results. It must fail on the original implementation by an assertion about the reported behavior and pass the repair.

Observe the regression fail before production repair, then run the repaired focused test and affected suite successfully. A retroactive counterfactual check alone does not prove the agent followed the required sequence.
Repair the accepted Unicode search without changing shelf-message or stock-total behavior, and finish the fix with current evidence, review and committed changes.

grader_files.checks/check_search_result.py:
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
app=runpy.run_path(str(Path.cwd()/"src/app.py"))
f=app["search_items"]
rows=[{"name":"Straße lamp","quantity":2},{"name":"Tea","quantity":1},{"name":"STRASSE shade","quantity":3}]
assert f(rows,"strasse")==[rows[0],rows[2]]
assert f(rows,"")==rows and f(rows,"missing")==[] and f([],"x")==[]
assert app["empty_message"]()=="No items saved."
assert app["stock_total"]([{"quantity":-3},{"quantity":5}])==2
